items.body_raw: The number of those who lapped (Pi. ptc.) was three hundred, and all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees.
items.answer_raw: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַמְלַקְקִים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיִּכְרְעוּ כָּל־יֶתֶר הָעָם עַל־בִּרְכֵּיהֶם

items.body_raw: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּרֶא כִּי הָרָתָה וַתֵּקַל גְּבִרְתָּהּ בְּעֵינֶיהָ
items.answer_raw: And she conceived; and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

items.body_raw: וַיָּסַר נֹחַ אֶת־מִכְסֵה הַתֵּבָה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה חָרְבוּ פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה
items.answer_raw: And Noah removed the covering of the ark; and he looked, and behold, the face of the ground was dry.

items.body_raw: וַיִּטַּע נֹחַ כֶּרֶם וַיֵּשְׁתְּ מִן־הַיַּיִן וַיִּשְׁכָּר וַיִּתְגַּל בְּתוֹךְ אָהֳלֹה
items.answer_raw: And Noah planted a vineyard, and he drank of the wine and was drunken; and he uncovered himself within his tent.

items.body_raw: נְטֵה יָדְךָ וְהַעַל אֶת־הַצְפַרְדְּעִים
items.answer_raw: Stretch forth thy hand and cause frogs to come up.

items.body_raw: וַיְהִי רִיב בֵּין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵה אַבְרָם וּבֵין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵה לוֹט וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ אַל־נָא תְהִי מְרִיבָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ
items.answer_raw: And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's cattle and the herdsmen of Lot's cattle; and they said to one another, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee.

items.body_raw: וַיֵּרָא יהוה אֶל־אַבְרָם וַיִּבֶן שָׁם אַבְרָם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה הַנִּרְאֶה אֵלָיו
items.answer_raw: And Yahweh appeared to Abram, and Abram built there an altar to Yahweh who had appeared to him.

items.body_raw: יְהִי שֵׁם יהוה מְבֹרָךְ
items.answer_raw: Let the name of Yahweh be blessed.

items.body_raw: ויראו השמרים איש יוצא מן־העיר ויאמרו לו הראנו נא את־מבוא העיר ועשינו עמך חסד ויראם את־מבוא העיר ויכו את־העיר לפי־חרב ואת־האיש שלחו וילך האיש ארץ החתים ויבן עיר ויקרא שמה לוז הוא שמה עד היום הזה
items.answer_raw: And the watchers saw a man coming out of the city, and they said to him, Show us, we pray thee, the entrance to the city, and we will deal with thee kindly. And he showed them the entrance to the city, and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but the man they let go. And the man went to the land of the Hittites; and he built a city, and called the name of it Luz; that is its name to this day.

items.body_raw: And Noah did according to all that Yahweh commanded him.
items.answer_raw: וַיַּעַשׂ נֹחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּהוּ יְהוָה

items.body_raw: And he commanded the priests, saying, Come up out of the Jordan; and they went up.
items.answer_raw: וַיְצַו אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִים לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיַּעֲלוּ

items.body_raw: And the man of God stretched out his hand and brought up the frogs, and Pharaoh saw the plagues, and he feared (with) a great fear.
items.answer_raw: וַיֵּט אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־יָדוֹ וַיַּעַל אֶת־הַצְפַרְדְּעִים וַיַּרְא פַרְעֹה אֶת־הַמַּכּוֹת וַיִּירָא יִרְאָה גְדוֹלָה

items.body_raw: And it came to pass, when they were in the field, that the man rose up against (אל) his friend and slew him.
items.answer_raw: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹתָם בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּקָם הָאִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ וַיַּהַרְגֵהוּ

items.body_raw: Let the waters be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear; and it was so.
items.answer_raw: יִקָּווּ הַמַּיִם אֶל־מָקוֹם אֶחָד וְתֵרָאֶה הַיַּבָּשָׁה וַיְהִי־כֵן

items.body_raw: And God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water, and she went and filled the bottle with-water, and made the boy drink.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּפְקַח אֱלֹהִים אֶת־עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא בְּאֵר מַיִם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתְּמַלֵּא אֶת־הַחֵמֶת מַיִם וַתַּשְׁקְ אֶת־הַנָּעַר

items.body_raw: Bow (נטה, Hiph.) thy heavens and come down.
items.answer_raw: הַט שָׁמֶיךָ וְתֵרֵד

items.body_raw: וַיְהִי כִרְאוֹתוֹ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲהָהּ בִּתִּי הַכְרֵעַ הִכְרַעְתִּנִי וְאַתְּ הָיִית בְּעֹכְרָי וְאָנֹכִי פָּצִיתִי פִי אֶל־יהוה וְלֹא אוּכַל לָשׁוּב
items.answer_raw: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his garments, and said, Alas, my daughter, thou hast bowed me down to the very ground. Yes, it is thou that art the cause of my calamity; for, as for me, I have made a solemn promise to Yahweh, and I cannot go back (upon it).

items.body_raw: And his daughters spoke to one another, saying: Let us make our father drink wine; and he drank and was drunken.
items.answer_raw: וַתֹּאמַרְנָה בְנֹתָיו אִשָּׁה אֶל־אֲחֹתָהּ לֵאמֹר נַשְׁקֶה אֶת־אָבִינוּ יַיִן וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיִּשְׁכָּר

items.body_raw: And again his wife bore a son; and, when he grew up, he loved his parents with all his heart, and did great good to his brothers and sisters.
items.answer_raw: וַתֹּסֶף אִשְׁתּוֹ לָלֶדֶת בֵּן וַיִּגְדַּל וַיֶּאֱהַב אֶת־אָבִיו וְאֶת־אִמּוֹ בְּכָל־לִבּוֹ וַיֶּרֶב לְהֵיטִיב לְאֶחָיו וּלְאַחְיוֹתָיו

items.body_raw: וְלָרָשׁ אֵין־כֹּל כִּי אִם־כִּבְשָׂה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה וַיְחַיֶּהָ וַתִּגְדַּל עִמּוֹ וְעִם־בָּנָיו יַחְדָּו מִפִּתּוֹ תֹאכַל וּמִכֹּסוֹ תִשְׁתֶּה וּבְחֵיקוֹ תִשְׁכָּב וַתְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבַת
items.answer_raw: The poor man had nothing but one little ewe-lamb, which he had bought and kept alive, and it grew up together with him and his children; it would eat of his morsel and drink of his cup and lie in his bosom, and it was like a daughter to him.

items.body_raw: וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה בְאֵר בַּשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם עֶדְרֵי־צֹאן רֹבְצִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי מִן־הַבְּאֵר הַהִיא יַשְׁקוּ הָעֲדָרִים
items.answer_raw: And he looked, and behold, a well in the field, and behold, there were flocks of sheep lying there by it, for out of that well they used to water the flocks.

items.body_raw: All this I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and prostrate thyself before me.
items.answer_raw: אֶת־כָּל־זֹאת נָתַתִּי לְךָ אִם־תִּקֹּד וְתִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לִי

items.body_raw: And the serpent was more cunning than all the beasts (sing.) of the field which God had made.
items.answer_raw: וַיְהִי הַנָּחָשׁ עָרוּם מִכֹּל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֱלֹהִים

items.body_raw: And that man was greater than all the children of (the) East.
items.answer_raw: וַיְהִי הָאִישׁ הַהוּא גָּדוֹל מִכָּל־בְּנֵי קֶדֶם

items.body_raw: And he lifted up his eyes and saw his brother, the son of his mother, and he said, Is this your youngest brother, whom ye mentioned (said) to me?
items.answer_raw: וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־אָחִיו בֶּן־אִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲזֶה אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָי

items.body_raw: And he had two daughters, and the younger was fairer than the elder.
items.answer_raw: וְלוֹ שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת וַתְּהִי הַקְּטַנָּה יָפָה מִן־הַגְּדוֹלָה

items.body_raw: And their gain was too much for dwelling together, and the land was not able to bear them.
items.answer_raw: וַיְהִי רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָכְלָה הָאָרֶץ לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם

items.body_raw: וַיְהִי בְּאַחַת וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה לְחַיָּיו בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ יָבְשָׁה הָאָרֶץ
items.answer_raw: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year of his life, in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

items.body_raw: ויחי אחרי־זאת מאה וארבעים שנה וירא את־בניו ואת־בני בניו ארבעה דרות
items.answer_raw: And after this he lived a hundred and forty years, and he saw his sons and his sons' sons—four generations.

items.body_raw: And there were born unto him three sons and seven daughters, and his substance was six thousand sheep, and four thousand camels, and seven hundred asses.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה בָנִים וְשֶׁבַע בָּנוֹת וַיְהִי מִקְנֵהוּ שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים צֹאן וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים גְּמַלִּים וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת חֲמוֹרִים

items.body_raw: וַיֵּבְךְּ וְכֹה אָמַר בְּלֶכְתּוֹ מִי יִתֵּן מוּתִי אֲנִי תַחְתֶּיךָ בְּנִי
items.answer_raw: And he wept; and thus he said, as he went, O that I had died instead of thee, my son.

items.body_raw: הַעְתִּירוּ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְיָסֵר מֵעָלַי אֶת־הַמָּוֶת הַזֶּה
items.answer_raw: Entreat Yahweh your God that he may remove this death from me.

items.body_raw: וישבע לה שאול ביהוה לאמר חי־יהוה אם־יקרך עון בדבר הזה ותאמר האשה את־מי אעלה־לך ויאמר את־שמואל העלי־לי ותרא האשה את־שמואל ותזעק בקול גדול ויאמר לה המלך אל־תיראי כי מה ראית ותאמר האשה אלהים ראיתי עלים מן־הארץ
items.answer_raw: And Saul swore to her by Yahweh, saying, As Yahweh liveth, there shall no punishment befall thee for this thing. Then the woman said, Whom shall I bring up for thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel. And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice. But the king said to her, Be not afraid; for what didst thou see? And the woman said, I saw a god coming up out of the earth.

items.body_raw: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי־טוֹב
items.answer_raw: God saw that it was good.

items.body_raw: וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הָרָקִיעַ
items.answer_raw: God made the expanse.

items.body_raw: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ
items.answer_raw: The king answered.

items.body_raw: וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בֹקֶר
items.answer_raw: And there was evening and there was morning.

items.body_raw: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים
items.answer_raw: Moses went up to God.

items.body_raw: יְהִי אוֹר
items.answer_raw: Let there be light.

items.body_raw: יְהוָה מָגִנִּי
items.answer_raw: Yahweh is my shield.

items.body_raw: אָרוּר הָאִישׁ
items.answer_raw: Cursed is the man.

items.body_raw: חֶלְקִי יְהוָה
items.answer_raw: Yahweh is my portion.

items.body_raw: בֶּחָג
items.answer_raw: At the feast

items.body_raw: יְהוָה סַלְעִי
items.answer_raw: Yahweh is my rock.

items.body_raw: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ
items.answer_raw: And he built an altar there.
